4\. A renewed state outage misses its alarm 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
unreadable_state_alarm() now passes a predicate that keeps every earlier state-unreadable alarm
since progress, even across an intervening ordinary alarm. If state recovers, an ordinary stall
alarm is posted, and state becomes unreadable again without newer progress, stall_alarm() treats
the previous outage's alarm and retry count as belonging to the new outage.
